user.title: Add appliance
user.description: Monitor an appliance through the power sensor of its smart plug.

data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor of the smart plug (W or kW).

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already monitored.

init.title: WashRData
init.description: What do you want to change?

settings.title: Detection settings
settings.description: Defaults come from the device type. The end delay is a minimum: WashRData raises it when your programs have longer quiet spells.

data_description.start_power_w: At or above this power the appliance counts as active.
data_description.stop_power_w: Below this power the appliance counts as quiet. Must not be above the start power.
data_description.end_delay_min: Quiet time after which a cycle counts as finished.
data_description.anti_crease: Short drum turns after the end are anti-crease, not a new cycle.
data_description.show_confidence: Confidence from which the recognised program, remaining time and end are shown.
data_description.auto_label_confidence: Confidence at the end from which a run gets the program by itself. Not below the display threshold.
data_description.price_entity: Entity with the price per kWh, e.g. input_number.strompreis_energie. Prices in ct/kWh are converted. Leave empty for no cost.
data_description.max_end_delay_min: The learned end delay never goes above this. Lower it if separate runs are merged.
data_description.resume_window_min: Activity this soon after the end continues the same cycle (e.g. a long soak). 0 turns it off. Lower it if you start the next wash quickly.

cycles.title: Edit cycles
cycles.description: The last {count} cycles, newest first: start, duration, energy, program and power curve. Choose one to check or correct its program.

cycle.title: Program of the cycle

data_description.program: Confirming a recognised program counts as set by hand.

error.stop_above_start: Stop power must not be above start power.
error.show_above_auto: The display threshold must not be above the labelling threshold.

options.no_devices: No WashRData appliance is set up yet.
options.accuracy_help: Rated are complete, labelled runs whose program already had references. ✓ recognition named the program surely enough to label it (labelling threshold), ○ it named the right program but too unsure to label it, ✗ it named another program. Only ✓ counts as a hit.
options.delete_confirm: Delete {program}? Its cycles are kept, without a program.
options.statistics_help: From the stored, complete runs with a program. Cost only for runs with a known price.
options.evaluation_pending: The evaluation runs shortly after start and after every change.
options.evaluation_empty: Nothing to evaluate yet: a program needs at least two labelled runs.
options.recommend_need: A recommendation needs at least {count} evaluated runs.
options.recommend: Recommended: display from {show}, label automatically from {auto}.
options.apply_confirm: Display programs from {show} and label automatically from {auto}? The appliance reloads briefly.
options.evaluation_intro: Every stored, labelled run is replayed against the other runs as references ({count} runs), as if it ran again now.
options.evaluation_help: Wrong shown: runs that showed a wrong program at some point. Right after: median minute the right program first appeared. Tendency: + means the remaining time was too long, − too short. Label wrong also counts first runs of a program that would get the name of another one.
options.replay_wrong: a wrong program shown in between
options.split_confirm: Split this cycle at {time} into two runs? Both lose their program and can be labelled again.
options.recommend_none: No safe threshold yet: every threshold that labels right runs would also label a run wrongly. Keep labelling by hand; more runs per program help.
options.evaluation_new: {count} of them were the first run of their program; they show whether a new program would get a wrong name.
options.replay_new_as: first run of its program, recognised as {program} ({confidence})
options.replay_new_unknown: first run of its program, rightly not recognised
options.hit_hint: Right, and sure enough to label it automatically
options.unsure_hint: right, but too unsure to label
options.unsure_of: {count} more recognised right, but too unsure to label them.
options.new_wrong_hint: new program, would have got this name

label_cycle.name: Label cycle
label_cycle.description: Assigns a program to a cycle. Unknown programs are created. Labelled cycles are used to recognise the program in future runs.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program name. Leave empty to remove the label.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: "current", "last" or a cycle id from the diagnostics. Default: the running cycle, otherwise the last one.

create_program.name: Create program
create_program.description: Adds a program to the program select.

rename_program.name: Rename program
rename_program.description: Renames a program, including its labelled cycles.

delete_program.name: Delete program
delete_program.description: Deletes a program. Its cycles are kept, unlabelled.

unknown_device.message: {device_id} is not a loaded WashRData device.
